gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Verifies that outerHtmlHead writes the DOCTYPE declaration including the internal subset bracket when one has been set via setInternalSubset, and that nodeName(
ADDED i3: Verifies that a DocumentType with all empty fields serializes to "<!doctype>" (HTML5 lowercase form) and that nodeName() returns "#doctype".
ADDED i4: Verifies that a DocumentType with both a public ID and a system ID serializes to the full "PUBLIC" form including both quoted identifiers.
ADDED i5: Verifies that in XML syntax mode an empty DocumentType serializes to "<!DOCTYPE>" (uppercase, as required by XML) even when name, publicId, and systemId are all
ADDED i6: Verifies that setPubSysKey with a non-null value updates the pubSysKey attribute without throwing, and that nodeName() still returns "#doctype".
ADDED i7: Verifies that setPubSysKey with a null argument is a no-op: it does not throw and nodeName() continues to return "#doctype".
ADDED i8: Verifies that systemId() returns exactly the system ID string passed to the constructor.
ADDED i9: Verifies that publicId() returns an empty string when an empty publicId was passed to the constructor.
ADDED i10: Verifies that name() returns exactly the name string passed to the constructor.
